targets.old_statement: Minors hold the learner permit 12 months conviction-free, log 50 hours with 10 at night under adult certification, and keep schooling.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Minors hold the learner permit twelve months conviction-free, log fifty hours with ten at night under adult certification, and keep schooling.
targets.statement: Drivers under eighteen must hold a learner license for twelve months or until turning eighteen, whichever comes first, go twelve months without moving-violation convictions except one withheld adjudication, log at least fifty driving hours including ten at night certified by a parent, guardian, or responsible adult twenty-one or older, submit parental consent, and maintain school attendance.

targets.old_statement: Class E licenses last 6 to 8 years; renewal takes the old card and a vision pass but refuses the ineligible, summons skippers, and suspended drivers.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Class E licenses last six to eight years; renewal takes the old card and a vision pass but refuses the ineligible, summons skippers, and suspended drivers.
targets.statement: A Class E driver license remains valid for six to eight years; renewal requires presenting your old license and passing a vision exam, and is denied if you are ineligible, left a traffic summons unanswered, hold a suspended, revoked, or canceled license, or fail to present required documentation.
